title: Sunset Hot Air Balloon Ride Over Phoenix
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children must be 5 years of age or older
Must be able to stand for 60 minutes unassisted
Must be able to sustain the impact of jumping off a chair
Unable to fly anyone who is pregnant
Passengers 300lbs+ must purchase an additional space to ensure safety, comfort, and proper weight distribution during flight
policies: This is a shared basket flight, there will be anywhere from 10-16 total passengers in each basket
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Enjoy a one-hour hot air balloon flight as the sun sets over the Sonoran Desert in Phoenix, Arizona. You'll experience breathtaking 360-degree views of the famous Sonoran Desert landscape throughout your flight. Upon landing, enjoy a celebratory toast and light refreshments.
